metadata.title: VMware.HCX
metadata.description: PowerShell Module for Managing Hybrid Cloud Extension (HCX) on VMware Cloud on AWS

findings.title: Possible hard-coded credential
findings.description: A credential-like variable appears to be assigned a literal value. Review the source; the matched value is redacted.

findings.title: Separate username and password parameters are declared
findings.description: Function 'Connect-HcxServer' has both Username and Password parameters. Either set the type of the Password parameter to SecureString or replace the Username and Password parameters with a Credential parameter of type PSCredential. If using a Credential parameter in PowerShell 4.0 or earlier, please define a credential transformation attribute after the PSCredential type attribute.
